summary: First full e2e test of AI in 15. Backend: 27 pytest tests, 26 pass. Only brute-force lockout fails (ineffective behind ingress). Frontend: all 14 requested flows verified via Playwright (register w/ East Africa optgroup, login/logout + wrong password error, dashboard cards/continue/progress, lesson A-F + safety notice + time labels, copy toast, edit/reset, quiz feedback, reflection, mark complete -> 1 of 14 / 7% / Day 2, persistence after re-login, reopen + re-save, tasks filter, prompt search/category/favourites persisted, profile update -> greeting, admin stats + edit title & MCQ -> visible to learner (restored afterwards), learner /admin redirect, API 401/403, AI Try it (GPT 6 Luna) and Feedback (Claude Sonnet 5.5) streaming, Google redirect, mobile 390px).

critical.issue: Brute-force lockout is ineffective. Identifier uses request.client.host, which is the rotating ingress pod IP (observed 10.211.2.82 and 10.211.2.85 for the same client), so failures spread across several keys and 6+ wrong attempts never return 429. Use the first IP from the X-Forwarded-For header (or lock on email alone).

minor.issue: After the 15-min lock expires the count is not reset, so the next single failure locks the account again for 15 min. Reset count when locked_until < now.
Daily quota is incremented before the LLM call, so failed/errored streams still consume the user's 30/day allowance.
Changing 'order' does not re-sequence other lessons; duplicate order values are allowed, which makes pathway order / 'Day N' labels ambiguous.

ui_bugs.issue: AI responses are shown as raw markdown (e.g. '**What works well**' with literal asterisks). Render markdown (e.g. react-markdown) or ask the model for plain text.

integration_issues.issue: No error handling or loading state: if /lessons, /progress or /favourites fails, the page stays blank (the component returns null) and shows no message.

action_items: Fix login lockout identifier to use the X-Forwarded-For client IP (or email only) so 5 failures -> 429
Reset the login attempt count once the lock has expired
Render AI output markdown in AIPanel
Add error/loading states to the useLearning hook consumers
Optionally: do not count failed AI calls against the quota; validate/re-sequence lesson order on admin save
critical_code_review_comments: Auth uses a Bearer token in localStorage, not httpOnly cookies (a deliberate design choice). CORS '*' with allow_credentials is acceptable only because cookies are not used.
bcrypt hashes use the $2b$ format; seed_admin only creates the admin if missing and never overwrites the password (it only re-sets role=admin). Good.
@app.on_event is deprecated; consider a lifespan handler.
Google login silently links to an existing email/password account with the same email (acceptable, but note it).
test_credentials: Admin from /app/memory/test_credentials.md works. Learner created: ui_bc975b@example.com / Learner123! (first name now Njeri, lesson-01 complete, lesson-02 favourited)
seed_data_creation: Test learners test_*@example.com and ui_*@example.com. Lesson-01 and lesson-14 were edited and restored to their original values (lesson-01 title 'Meet your AI assistant', correct_index 1).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest backend/tests/test_ai15_api.py with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL exported. test_brute_force_lockout is expected to fail until the X-Forwarded-For fix. The AI test makes one Gemini call. In headless mode the copy toast appears through the execCommand fallback.
rca of the issue: Lockout: identifier=f'{request.client.host}:{email}'. Behind the k8s ingress, client.host is the proxy pod IP, which alternates between replicas. Confirmed in the login_attempts collection: the same email had count 4 under 10.211.2.82 and count 2 under 10.211.2.85, so neither reached 5. Fix: ip = request.headers.get('x-forwarded-for','').split(',')[0].strip() or request.client.host.
